briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating global race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while compute investments accelerated. Regulatory scrutiny intensified on export controls and safety benchmarks. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain critical unsolved issues.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google launched Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant; xAI and DeepSeek announced new training runs. Model performance gains continue at rapid pace.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramped production; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k+ GPU clusters; TSMC expanded advanced packaging capacity for AI chips. Energy constraints are emerging as primary bottleneck.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI be achieved through scaled pretraining or through novel multi-agent protocol architectures?
